A simple question by Sheldon Glashow changed the course of physics forever, leading to the development of the Standard Model and the discovery of the Higgs boson. The Standard Model explains the fundamental particles and forces, but it has limitations, such as not accounting for gravity and the mass of particles. Physicists continue to explore new ideas, including the use of artificial intelligence to solve complex problems and discover new insights.
